blogs.title: Ceramic Steel vs Melamine Whiteboard: Which Surface Lasts Longer in Kolkata?
blogs.meta_description: Discover why ceramic vitreous steel writing boards resist Kolkata monsoon humidity and marker ghosting far better than cheap commercial melamine.
blogs.content:
The Science of Board Surfaces

Educational institutions in West Bengal face a unique challenge: high atmospheric humidity during monsoons. Inferior commercial whiteboards absorb moisture through unsealed backings, leading to warped frames and stubborn marker ghosting within weeks.

Vitreous Enamelled Ceramic Steel

Manufactured by fusing porcelain enamel to heavy gauge steel at over 800°C, creating a glass-smooth surface that is 100% non-porous. Marker ink wipes off cleanly even after being left on the board for over 6 months.

Key Advantages of Shaw Enterprise Boards

  • Virgin 6063-T6 Aluminium: Resists bending under student weight or heavy vibration.
  • Moisture-Resistant Backing: 0.25mm galvanized anti-rust backing prevents moisture ingress.
  • Ghost-Free Warranty: Certified for over 100,000 erase cycles.

blogs.title: How to Properly Clean & Restore Whiteboards: Factory Maintenance Hacks
blogs.meta_description: Practical guide from Shaw Enterprise workshop on reviving stained writing boards and preventing dry-wipe marker residue.
blogs.content:
Never Use Harsh Abrasives

One of the most common mistakes schools make is cleaning writing boards with abrasive powders or harsh solvents like acetone. These destroy the micro-thin polymer coating, creating microscopic pores that permanently trap marker pigments.

The Safe Shaw Enterprise Cleaning Protocol

  1. Wipe board thoroughly with a clean micro-fibre felt duster.
  2. Spray a 50/50 mixture of isopropyl alcohol and distilled water or our specialized Board Cleaner.
  3. Allow solution to break down solvent waxes for 30 seconds.
  4. Wipe dry with a clean micro-fibre towel in circular motions.
